options.text: It stays put; the reaction just gets faster.
options.feedback: Kabir's card: "Heat is speed, not direction."

options.text: It moves toward the products, because splitting gains ways and ways count more when it is hot.
It moves toward the reactants, because heat is a reactant.

image.alt: Water molecules on a valley curve at room temperature, and the same curve beside a blazing sun surface, where the floor might shift.
